description: UK Regional and Area CKD, Diabetes and Hypertension Prevalence Indicators (OHID Fingertips & QOF 2024-2025)

nationalAverages.source: Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) / NHS England

regions.notes: Higher proportion of younger, diverse population; higher diabetic kidney risk among South Asian and Black populations.
Covers Coventry, Birmingham, and Black Country; significant target population for early CKD education and prevention.
Includes Leeds and Bradford; focus on cardiovascular comorbidity management.
Higher age-standardised rate of multimorbidity and social deprivation indices.
